glance.showingNofM: Showing {active} of {total} files, ranked by structural centrality.

historyStarvedCaveat: Ranking is limited: the coupling graph had no edges (fresh clone or too few commits). File order reflects size, not structural centrality.

pitch.empty: A repository with no readable text files{detail}.

shape.bulk: Densely interconnected codebase: most files participate in one large neighbourhood of shared change.
shape.crystalline: Lattice-shaped codebase: uniform, regular coupling across files with predictable local structure.
shape.goe: Richly interconnected codebase: couplings spread across files without a dominant spine.
shape.modular: Modular codebase: several cohesive regions with limited cross-coupling. Work in one region rarely disturbs another.
shape.poisson: Loosely coupled codebase: files evolve mostly on their own, with occasional shared change.
shape.tree: Tree-shaped codebase: one dominant spine with dependent branches. Change usually propagates outward from the core.
